title: D2P Body Model Expectation
description: Machine-readable expectation for the body models of one body source and avatar profile, used by fixtures (catalog §4.6): the expected status, every control-measure target with its origin (profile, size table or inferred) and its tolerance. A conforming body model of the source has these targets and stays within these tolerances (AVA-001). Meshes are not expected results.
$comment: Schema catalog section 3.9 (draft 0.3.0). Targets are checked against the source and the avatar profile (D2P-SEM-127).

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

expectedStatus.description: Status every conforming body model of this source and profile has: 'failed' when a required definition has no value (AVA-003).

controlMeasures.description: Expected targets with their origin and tolerance, sorted by definitionId (D2P-SEM-127).

missingDefinitions.description: Required definitions without a value (sorted, unique; omitted when none).

toleranceProfile.description: Tolerance profile body models are compared with.

personalDerived.description: True when the document derives from a body measurement profile classified 'personal' or 'sensitive-personal' (directly or through a pinned body model or scene). Such a document is geometry or data derived from personal data and is served only under the export rules of that profile; a document that derives from such a profile without stating true is reported as D2P-SEM-050. Absent means false.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).

expectedBodyMeasure.title: Expected body measure
expectedBodyMeasure.description: Expected target of one control measure.

origin.description: Where the target comes from (body target resolution).

maxDeviationMm.description: Tolerance of the avatar profile for this definition.
